posts.preview: We are honoured to welcome our inspiration, SWAPO Party Secretary General, Honourable Sophia Naahango Shaningwa, to officiate the first SWAPO Party Samora Machel District Leadership Training

Cde Sophia is a unique and inspiring leader to many of us who have served as General Secretaries of trade unions. The position comes with many challenges, and only through passion and love for the people can one emerge victorious
